meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 Centinela(QA)代理做安全审计:跑 OWASP Top 10 检查、扫描硬编码密钥、查依赖 CVE,把报告写到 docs/reviews/ 并给出 APPROVED 或 CHANGES REQUIRED 结论。
howto.when: 在发版前、涉及认证或数据处理的重大改动后,或新增依赖与外部集成时触发。不指定范围时审计整个 src/ 目录。

say.note: 默认审计整个 src/ 目录

say.text: 查一下这个项目有没有硬编码的 API key 和 token
say.note: 属于审计中的密钥扫描环节

howto.what_en: Runs a security audit through the Centinela (QA) agent: OWASP Top 10 checks, secrets scanning, and dependency CVE review, then writes a report to docs/reviews/ with an APPROVED or CHANGES REQUIRED verdict.
howto.when_en: Use before a release, after major changes to authentication or data handling, or when adding dependencies and integrations. Without a scope, the whole src/ directory is audited.

say_en.note: Audits the whole src/ directory by default

say_en.text: Check this project for hardcoded API keys and tokens
say_en.note: Part of the audit's secrets scan
